_comments.data: Path to a CSV file  OR  'MSL' / 'SMAP'
_comments.cutoff: ISO date to split train/test in CSV mode (e.g. '2021-09-01'). null = use val_split instead
_comments.val_split: Fraction of training data held out for validation (0.0–1.0)
_comments.datasets_dir: Root directory containing MSL/SMAP pickle files. null = auto-detect
_comments.output_dir: Where to save outputs. null = output/<timestamp>/
_comments.fc_layers: Number of FC layers in forecasting head
_comments.recon_layers: Number of GRU layers in reconstruction head
_comments.gamma: Weight for reconstruction error in anomaly score (1.0 = equal weight)
_comments.pot_q: POT initial quantile for tail threshold (e.g. 0.001 = top 0.1 %)
